payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate remote-version cleanup found a release gap: CR-108 now pins crate-rust-backend to the remote Frick Git tag 0.4.0 instead of the sibling worktree, and that tag does not expose BootSeams.auth_lifecycle / AuthLifecycle / FirstSignInContext. The hook appears only in the local dirty Frick worktree, so Crate cannot preserve first-sign-in tenant bootstrap from the remote 0.4.0 tag. Please publish/tag the auth lifecycle seam (or create a 0.4.1 release) before treating this as consumable by Crate without local path dependencies.
